title: Integral Identities and Rigidity of Generalized $m$-Quasi-Einstein Manifolds
summary: We prove that every closed $m$-quasi-Einstein manifold $(M^n,g,X,λ)$ with constant $λ\leq0$ is trivial whenever $m\leq-2$. This establishes the Colling--Dunajski conjecture in the range $m\leq-2$ and, for $n\geq5$, extends the previously known range $m\leq2-n$. This result is placed within a broader study of closed generalized $m$-quasi-Einstein manifolds $(M^n,g,X,λ)$. We establish differential and integral identities for such manifolds. These identities yield criteria for conformality, the Killing condition, and triviality, and provide a unified framework for several rigidity phenomena.…
